title: AtomRegistration
description: The four-layer atom contract: identity, context interface, composition declaration, and history anchoring. This is the registration envelope that declares what an atom is and how it behaves. Every conformant atom must satisfy this shape.

entityType.description: Stable atom identity. Must be a literal string (e.g., 'jurisdiction', 'parcel', 'task').

domain.description: Required, queryable domain grouping. Atoms are grouped by domain for prompt-builder derivation and catalog filtering.

supportedModes.description: Render modes the atom implementation supports.

defaultMode.description: Default mode used when the caller does not specify one. Must be a member of supportedModes.

accessPolicy.description: Atom-type default access tier per ADR-017. Surfaces that gate on visibility treat an omitted field as 'public-free'. Per-instance overrides flow through the context summary.

eventTypes.description: Optional, machine-readable list of event-type strings this atom is allowed to emit. Convention: dotted names namespaced by entityType (e.g., 'sheet.created', 'snapshot.referenced-in-submission').

composition.description: Declarative composition graph. Pass an empty array to declare 'no children'. The field is required so a registration cannot silently omit the composition layer.

items.description: A single composition edge declaring a child atom type.

childType.description: Entity type of the child atom.

provenance.description: Provenance fields declaring how this atom instance was sourced.

sourceAdapter.description: Identifier of the adapter that sourced this atom (e.g., 'buildingeye-api', 'assessor-scraper').

sourceUrl.description: URL or URI of the original data source.

contentHash.description: Hash of the source content for tamper-detection and cache invalidation.

fetchedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the atom was fetched from the source.
